## Donor / code-line control

**ACTIVE LINE:** TEST KING / LIVE KING / DONOR / RECOVERY

**DONOR DECISION:** ADOPT / ALREADY PRESENT / REJECT WITH REASON / DEFER WITH REASON

**LIVE KING affected:** NO by default. Any production promotion requires separate accepted evidence and release authority.

## GOLD / WORLD CLASS gate

- [ ] One dominant idea, visual anchor and next action are clear.
- [ ] Five-second, squint, scan and next-action tests pass.
- [ ] No material dead end; supported context survives navigation.
- [ ] HUMAN CRAFT / AI-WASH completed on rendered UI and source.
- [ ] AI-Wash findings were DELETE / MERGE / REUSE / SUBORDINATE / JUSTIFY, not cosmetic restyling only.
- [ ] Existing GOLD primitives were reused unless a bounded exception is documented.
- [ ] Desktop rendered evidence reviewed.
- [ ] 390×844 and 430×932 rendered/touch evidence reviewed.
- [ ] No critical interaction depends on hover.
- [ ] Keyboard, visible focus and reduced-motion behaviour reviewed.
- [ ] WCAG 2.2 AA target checks relevant to the change pass.
- [ ] Performance/media/data loading reviewed for unnecessary cost or layout shift.
- [ ] Source, interpretation, planned, unavailable and test-only states remain distinct.
- [ ] No unsupported LIVE, partner, delivery, outcome or maturity claim introduced.
- [ ] Exact SHA, build/test/browser evidence and known limitations are supplied.
- [ ] Material learning has been written back or explicitly marked not generalisable.
